verdict.rationale: Netlify's own Deploy Previews give every PR a separate preview URL, so changes can be tested in a real isolated deployment, not a dry run, before production; community users confirm per-PR preview builds. The evidence does not show that previews use data separate from production, and the claim that Netlify Database lets you 'safely iterate' is vague. missing for 10: documented separation of preview data from production (e.g. database branching or per-preview data stores), environment-scoped secrets for previews, agent-specific sandbox workflow docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Every PR gets a preview URL.
Share preview URLs of your in-progress content and code so you can review before launching changes to production.
Deploy and safely iterate on managed Postgres with **Netlify Database**
The killer feature is the GitHub integration that renders a preview build of every PR.
